children.text: This is a Iconset plugin of Amber Weather.
You need to install Amber Weather Version 0.9 or above to use this Iconset.
Contact us if you can't get update to Version 0.9.
This is a Iconset plugin of Amber Weather.
Click the store button on the bar of main page,then switch to the ICONSET,find this app and apply it.
Hide the icon of the app in your launcher.
